## Development

Aflah builds responsive frontends, APIs, database models and integrations. His toolkit includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Redis.

## Selected work

The project previews on the portfolio are illustrative interface concepts based on Aflah's development experience.

### Core Engineering Job Portal

A specialized job platform connecting mechanical, civil, and electrical engineers with opportunities. Built with dedicated candidate, company, and admin experiences.

Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, PostgreSQL.

- Role-based dashboards for candidates, recruiters, and administrators.
- Server-side rendering with Next.js and TypeScript for fast, searchable pages.
- GraphQL APIs and a PostgreSQL database for job posting, application tracking, and profile management.

### Fleet Management Platform

An operations platform that brings vehicles, drivers, routes, and maintenance into one place, giving teams a clear view of their fleet.

Technologies: React, Node.js, MongoDB, REST APIs.

- Responsive analytics dashboards with live status updates and reporting.
- GPS tracking integration, trip logs, service reminders, and automated reports.
- Secure REST APIs, role-based access, and optimized MongoDB schemas.

### NILA Tap-to-Earn Application

A Telegram-integrated application for NILA Token, with interactive tasks, wallet linking, and real-time rewards.

Technologies: Angular, .NET, PostgreSQL, Redis.

- Angular frontend with secure .NET services for authentication and transactions.
- Reward calculations, wallet linking, and real-time data processing.
- Redis caching and in-app monetization built for a responsive user experience.
